name: alexandria
description: Digest-bound lending-data releases with explicit capture coverage and a narrow Tabularium credit view for Probitas.

interface.shortDescription: Digest-bound lending-data archive and credit view
interface.longDescription: Alexandria preserves heterogeneous lending-protocol captures as unchanged digest-addressed objects, binds them to exact scope and coverage, derives reviewed Goldfinch and Clearpool credit rows, and rebuilds a disposable address index for Probitas. Verification is offline. The Compound v3 collector is specified but not implemented.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $alexandria to preserve or verify this lending-data release, or query its source-bound credit view.
